Export Data

Export timesheets and reports as CSV files compatible with MYOB AccountRight

MYOB AccountRight Import

The MYOB Timesheet CSV export uses the Payroll Activity format. Go to MYOB → Payroll → Timesheets → Import, then select the downloaded file. Map columns: Co./Last Name → Employee Last Name, First Name → Employee First Name, Payroll Category → Payroll Category, Date → Date, Hours → Hours.
